packageRules.description: Wow 10 ships pre-releases only: follow them, Gradle plugin, BOM and TypeScript packages together (one version everywhere)
Group Spring ecosystem updates into a single PR
Group Kotlin + KSP updates (KSP version must match Kotlin version)
Pin typescript until typescript-eslint supports TS 7 (typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940)
Group @ahoo-wang/fetcher ecosystem updates into a single PR
Group Testcontainers modules into a single PR
CoSec 8 ships pre-releases alongside Wow 10: follow them as one group
engines.node is the published client's promise to its users (the oldest supported Node LTS): change it by hand. The Node used to develop and build is client/.node-version
CI's JDK must equal the build toolchain (JDK 21 in build-logic, the bytecode baseline of blog-api), and detekt 1.23 cannot run on JDK 25: raise its major together with the toolchain, by hand
